functions.purpose: CryEngine-style log initialization. Reads DebugLog section of system.cfg/user.cfg via GetPrivateProfileStringA/IntA: LogPath, DebugLog filename (builds '-[%H.%M]-All.log' timestamped name via strftime), Summary verbosity, EnableSvrProfiler, DebugLogEnable, and per-subsystem verbosity for channels System/BatStatistics/BattleProcessCtrl/CryEngine/Damage/Guild/MovementDebug/Movement/PositionBlock/PositionCheck/Security/ServerFG/Verify/MHScriptSystem/Firework/StaticData/PlayerState. Sets each channel object's +0x44 verbosity field (clamped <9) and profiler flag at +0xcc.
formulas: Summary verbosity default 6; written to logCtx+0x44 only if value<9
each subsystem channel struct: +0x44 = verbosity level (must be <9); +0xcc = debug-log-enable flag (set 1 when EnableSvrProfiler==0 && DebugLogEnable!=0, else 0)
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (stock CryEngine logging plumbing; 'Guild' is one of the log channels)
functions.notes: DAT_123bc994/DAT_123ba6bc are global log-manager/channel pointers. Guild channel object pointer stored at DAT_123ba6fc (see FUN_100f1630).

functions.purpose: Per-subsystem log-verbosity applier. For each named DebugLog channel reads GetPrivateProfileIntA('DebugLog', <name>, default) and writes the value (if <9) into that channel object's +0x44 field. param_1!=0 skips the optional/verbose channels. Guild channel object at global DAT_123ba6fc.
formulas: value clamped: written to channelObj+0x44 only if value<9
